correctness.rationale: For every n>=4 the Pauli action preserves weight two only at flip counts 0,2,4; parity and six-choice combinatorics give all exact labelled magnitudes. Their exact multiplicities yield every positive-power moment. Rational binomial sums independently establish the exact T_2 polynomial. CLT plus sub-Gaussian uniform moment bounds prove all asymptotic and critical-window limits; no finite test is used as an infinite proof. Standard-library direct Pauli-action tests through n=8 and exact moment tests through n=30 returned VERIFY_OK. Limits: n>=4 and fixed alpha>1 or fixed s in the window.

value.rationale: The complete Pauli-magnitude law is a natural all-order invariant for the canonical exactly-two-excitation symmetric Dicke family, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The order-two rational identity and sharp three-sector crossover distinguish how distinct classes of correlations compete as the Rényi index varies. The 1/log(n) critical window with exact coefficients 60,192,112 provides a usable analytic magic benchmark not supplied by existing weight-resolved second moments or generic algorithms; no downstream quantum speedup is asserted.
